visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fixed image with sliding text highlights
visualCharacteristics.description: A fixed image beside (from 1024px) or above a dark navy panel. Each row text cell is a slide (H4 + paragraph); dash tabs switch slides (red = active). Keyboard accessible tabs (arrow keys, Home/End), swipe on touch, no autoplay. The block has a cut-off top-right corner.
visualCharacteristics.source: Industry pages: .industries-slider (Page Builder slick slider with dots, autoplay off).

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide: image cell | text cell. Only the first row image is used; later image cells may be empty
rows: Image (fixed; optional second image = mobile crop)

reuseGuidance: Use when one static image accompanies several short text slides. For full image slides use carousel.
